segments.sn35.76:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.76:1.3: “sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu, yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyan”ti.
segments.sn35.76:1.4: “Yaṃ kho, rādha, aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.76:1.5: Kiñca, rādha, aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo?
segments.sn35.76:1.8: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccaṃ. Tatra te chando pahātabbo … pe …
segments.sn35.76:1.11: mano anicco. Tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.76:1.15: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccaṃ. Tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.76:1.16: Yaṃ kho, rādha, aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo”ti.

lines: Navopi hi koci paññāto hoti rāhulatthero viya sumanasāmaṇero viya ca, ayaṃ pana navo ceva apaññāto ca.
74-78. Appaññātoti nāmagottato ceva sīlādiguṇehi ca appaññāto avissuto.
